summary: Rabbi Harari discusses the halakhic status of reading the Haftarah as part of the practice of Shnayim Mikra ve-Echad Targum. He examines the differing rationales provided by early authorities for this practice and explains why the Shulhan Arukh does not require it. The class concludes by noting that while some follow a minhag to prepare the Haftarah, it is not a mandatory obligation in contemporary practice.
questions: Is there an obligation to read the Haftarah as part of Shnayim Mikra?
Why does the Shulhan Arukh not mention reading the Haftarah?
What is the difference between the approaches of Rabbeinu Simcha and Rabbeinu Hananel?
Should one prepare the Haftarah for holidays?
Does the current practice of the Baal Koreh reading the Haftarah affect the need for personal preparation?
